{#- "Recibo de Vencimentos" — Angola payroll receipt. Laid out to match the PRIMAVERA BSS receipt this replaces: no fills, no boxes, no rounded corners; hairline rules and whitespace do all the separating work. Literals are written in Angolan Portuguese and deliberately NOT wrapped in _(): the receipt is a legal document that must read identically regardless of the viewing user's language, and Frappe's "pt" catalogue translates the English word "Data" to "Dados", which corrupted the date column header. Every figure is copied from the Isoft Salary Slip. Nothing here computes payroll. -#} {%- set r = isoft_recibo_context(doc) -%} {%- set cur = r.currency or "" -%} {#- Money, in the site's number format, without a currency symbol: the column headings and "Total Pago ( AKZ )" already state the currency. -#} {%- macro money(v) -%}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(v or 0) }}{%- endmacro -%} {#- Day and hour counters keep their two decimals ("21,00"), the way the receipt this replaces prints them. -#} {%- macro qty(v) -%}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(v or 0) }}{%- endmacro -%} {#- Blank rather than "0,00": an absence column with nothing in it should read as empty. -#} {%- macro qty0(v) -%}{% if v %}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(v) }}{% endif %}{%- endmacro -%} {#- Exchange rate carries eight decimals. fmt_money caps at the currency's precision, so the separators are applied by hand. -#} {%- macro rate8(v) -%}{{ ("%.8f" | format(v | float)) | replace(".", ",") }}{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro d_full(v) -%}{% if v %}{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(v, "dd/MM/yyyy") }}{% endif %}{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro d_month(v) -%}{% if v %}{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(v, "MM-yyyy") }}{% endif %}{%- endmacro -%} {#- Pad the lines table to a fixed height so "Total" and the signature always land in the same place, the way pre-printed payroll stationery does. -#} {%- set used = r.earnings | length + r.deductions | length + r.memos | length -%} {#- The overtime block below eats into the same page, so it is charged against the same budget: its own rows plus a caption and a heading row. -#} {%- set ot_lines = (r.overtime.rows | length + 3) if r.overtime.show else 0 -%} {%- set filler = [0, 14 - used - ot_lines] | max -%}
